question: Does the relationship between cell composition (b2) and the darkturquoise module eigengene differ between groups? Does the control-lith composition-adjusted difference survive a model with group × composition interactions?
rationale: Analysis 007 showed: r(dt_ME, b2) = -0.13 in controls, -0.39 in bp_nolith, -0.44 in bp_lith. The weaker coupling in controls could mean the linear composition adjustment over-corrects for BP vs under-corrects for controls, explaining the surviving control-lith difference. A group × b2 interaction term tests this directly.
pre_specified_tests: LM: dt_ME ~ group * b2 + b1 + b3 + b4 (group×b2 interaction)
LRT: compare group*b2 model to additive group+b1+b2+b3+b4
If interaction significant: re-test control-lith pairwise within interaction model
